description: Find and compare Nemlig groceries, collect choices in a Local basket, and add them to Nemlig only after authorization.

interface.defaultPrompt: Show my current Local basket if one exists. If it is empty, introduce how it works and offer to find a product, plan groceries, or find dinner ingredients. Do not add anything to my Nemlig basket.
interface.longDescription: Search current Nemlig products, compare sizes and prices, and collect choices in a temporary Local basket. Nothing is added to the real Nemlig basket until you explicitly ask to add the current list.

name: nemlig-shopping
